tweets.text: Read the Bloomberg piece here: https://t.co/po6rYlBAFL

Yejin Choi (@YejinChoinka) is one of the ~30 computer scientists to ever win a MacArthur "Genius" grant. She and her cofounder Carlos Guestrin (@guestrin) are both prolific Stanford Computer Science professors, each with an h-index >100. 

Their students and research have driven some of the seminal work in the field of AI today. They are also academics who bring rare industry experience from their leadership roles at Nvidia and Apple. 

Today, they're announcing that their startup Noeri (@noeri_ai) is coming out of stealth to build specialized, cost-effective AI systems that learn from real work in companies and self-improve. 

We at Menlo are privileged to lead their inception round!
